tool_summary: Creates hard or symbolic links between files. A symlink can point outside the intended directory scope, and -f silently overwrites an existing link or file at the target.
platform_notes: Core flag semantics (-s, -f) are consistent between GNU and BSD ln.

rules.description: The -f/--force flag combined with -s/--symbolic silently overwrites an existing file or link at the destination with a new symlink, which can redirect subsequent reads/writes through that path to an unexpected location without any confirmation.
rules.reversible_note: The overwritten file or link's prior target is not recoverable by ln itself.

rules.description: Creates a hard or symbolic link. A symlink pointing outside the intended directory scope can redirect subsequent reads or writes through that path to an unexpected location.
